items.title: Blasts reported in Iran as US launches new wave of strikes
items.description: The US says its attacks aim to "further degrade Iranian military capabilities", as fighting continued for the sixth day in a row.

items.title: Zelensky's removal of popular defence minister sparks protests in Ukraine
items.description: A rift between Fedorov and Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi was apparently at the heart of Zelensky's decision.

items.title: Teenager accused of carrying out sabotage actions in Poland for Russia
items.description: Polish security services say the aim was to incite ethnic tensions between Poland and Ukraine.

items.title: Fifa 'assessing match reports' over Falklands banner
items.description: Fifa is "assessing the match reports" before deciding whether to punish Argentina after players held a banner in support of their country's claims to the Falkland Islands.

items.title: Italian officials handed jail terms for Genoa bridge disaster that killed 43
items.description: The ex-head of Italy's motorway operator Giovanni Castellucci was handed a 12-year term over the 2018 bridge collapse.

items.title: White House teleprompter operator accused of making $100k off Trump speech bets
items.description: A White House staffer has been accused of using inside knowledge of speeches to make nearly $100,000 on Kalshi.

items.title: Hundreds of Canada wildfires prompt US air quality alerts as smoke spreads south
items.description: Smoke from more than 800 blazes has affected cities from Toronto to New York, as well as the US Midwest.

items.title: Kris Jenner's mother Mary Jo dies aged 91
items.description: Mary Jo 'MJ' Campbell was featured on multiple episodes of Keeping Up with the Kardashians over the years.

items.title: At least one dead in Texas floods ravaging same area where campers died
items.description: The same area devastated by floods last year - causing more than 130 deaths, including those at Camp Mystic - is once again being hit.

items.title: 'Moment of joy' as Uganda discharges last Ebola patient
items.description: The good news from Uganda comes as the WHO chief warns the virus in DR Congo is spreading fast.

items.title: Volunteer firefighter suspected of starting devastating France forest fire
items.description: President Macron said there would be no leniency for arsonists, as France - along with much of Europe - deals with a series of unusual heatwaves.

items.title: Children among dead at Algeria foster care home blaze - president
items.description: Eleven people have died and 19 other have suffered injuries in the overnight fire, the authorities say.
